answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: every reward earned by an agent flows into a vesting kernel that releases it linearly over many epochs, so identity reputation acts like a slow pulse rather than a lump sum. A flash-farm operator spinning up thousands of fake identities collects only a thin slice before forfeiting the rest, and each new echo of the attack costs fresh stake, time, and lockup risk, making mass fabrication economically irrational while long-lived honest agents keep full earnings.
